verdict.rationale: Omarchy is a desktop Linux distribution with its own CLI and bundled agent harnesses, not a hosted service with an API that issues credentials. The openapi probe returns 404 on every candidate path, and nothing in the pack shows Omarchy minting API tokens of any kind, so scoped or least-privilege API credentials are outside this product type. Its agent features (default harnesses, agent skills, the `omarchy` CLI) concern running agents locally and say nothing about issuing credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
